summary: Removes a specific node (a2) from a doubly-linked list rooted at this+0x148. Walks from the list head comparing node pointers until a2 is found; if found, relinks the previous node's next link to the next node and the next node's back link to the previous node, updates the head at this+0x148 when a2 was the head, then runs sub-resource cleanup sub_5574B0, the no-op stub EmptyStub_7470, and frees the node via FreeWrapper_7bcf. In all paths it decrements the node count at this+0x144 and, when that count was 1, clears the head to 0. Returns 0.

operations.description: Start the walk at the list head stored in this+0x148.
Guard: proceed with the removal only when the list head at this+0x148 is non-null; otherwise jump straight to the count decrement.
Walk the list following each node's forward (next) link until the current node equals the target a2, or bail out early when the chain ends without finding a2.
Read the previous-node pointer (node+100) and, if non-null, set its +104 forward link to the removed node's next, relinking around the target.
Read the next-node pointer (node+104) and, if non-null, set its +100 backward link to the removed node's previous, completing the unlink.
If the removed node was the list head, set the head at this+0x148 to the removed node's next.
Call sub_5574B0 on the removed node to clean up its sub-resources before freeing.
Call EmptyStub_7470 on the removed node (no-op stub invoked before the free).
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf to heap-free the removed node.
Decrement the node count at this+0x144; if the count was 1 before the decrement, clear the list head at this+0x148 to 0.
